subject: Secure SDLC assurance package for SIG intake — codeflow, CI gates, secrets
messages:
From: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@trustassure.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: security@finservco.com
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake — confirm SDLC artifacts we need

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for agreeing to the SIG intake call. To speed our review, can you confirm whether you can provide the following artifacts for the Secure SDLC section:
- PR review logs and approver list for main branches (last 6 months)
- CI gate definitions (what checks block merges) and sample CI run output for a gated promotion
- Secrets provisioning flow and short-lived credential proof (how long, rotation cadence)
- Change management approvals for emergency and non-emergency releases (matrix)
- Evidence of KMS/HSM integration for production secrets

We often accept redacted logs or sanitized console output. Ideally provide a single archive or links. Goal is to complete the SIG questionnaire by next Wednesday.

Best,
Audrey
TrustAssure — Vendor Risk Team
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@trustassure.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — confirm SDLC artifacts we need

Hi Audrey — thanks for the list. We can provide everything requested. A few quick notes up front:
- We will sanitize PII and customer identifiers before sharing logs.
- CI sample will include a failing gating job and a successful promotion job to show enforcement.
- Secrets are managed via AWS KMS + our ephemeral vault for runners; tokens are 15m by default.
- Change approvals are recorded in Jira and mirrored into our approval spreadsheet; emergency change flow includes post-facto approvals for critical fixes.

I'll assemble an archive and share a Drive folder link by EOD Monday. Tagging Monica and Rishi for attachments and the KMS snippet.

-Karthik
Senior Security PM, Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@trustassure.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — confirm SDLC artifacts we need

Hi all — attaching the pack in Drive and dropping key highlights inline. See Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d5e

Attachment highlights (redacted):
- code_review_log_202606.tar.gz — includes PR metadata CSV (author, reviewers, approvals, timestamps) and a summarized reviewer count per PR. We enforce at least one >senior engineer approver for main/production branches.
- ci_run_2458-console.txt — sample run that failed lint, blocked merge; shows gating hook rejecting the merge until lint fixed. Also included run 2464 which shows the promotion after fix.
- change_approval_matrix.csv — shows escalation paths, required approvers by risk level, and SLA for approvals. Emergency flags captured in Jira issue comments.
- kms_config_snippet.txt — includes KMS key aliasing and policy excerpt (redacted ARNs).

Quick process notes:
- PR gating: merge blocked until CI passes and required approvers sign off (branch protection + MEL checks).
- CI: self-hosted runners in VPC; secrets supplied at runtime via vault-agent, no long-lived tokens in CI agents.
- Secrets rotation: KMS rotation enabled annually; Vault leases default 15 minutes, max 1 hour for special ops.
- Change mgmt: releases require a release ticket, approvals, and a post-release verification ticket.

Let me know if you need raw logs for a specific date range or additional context.

-Monica
Engineering Manager, Release Reliability
From: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@trustassure.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: security@finservco.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — quick clarifications

Thanks Monica — this is very helpful. A couple clarifying asks before we mark as complete:
1) For code_review_log_202606.tar.gz: can you include the reviewer github handles mapped to internal role (e.g., "senior engineer", "team lead") — a simple mapping CSV is fine.
2) For CI runs: please include the job id that demonstrates a policy-enforced rollback path (we saw an automated revert in a prior vendor review).
3) For KMS snippet: indicate whether keys are multi-region and whether rotation is automated.

If you can drop the additional files into the same Drive folder by EOD today we'll be set for our SIG reviewer.

Best,
Audrey
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@trustassure.com>, monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — quick clarifications

Audrey — uploaded the extras to the same Drive folder. Added files:
- reviewer_role_map.csv — maps GitHub handles to job level and team.
- ci_run_rollback_id.txt — contains job id 2471 which triggered an automated rollback and includes a short note on the automated revert hook.
- kms_key_properties.txt — confirms single-region key (us-west-2) with automatic annual rotation enabled; cross-account access via a strict IAM policy.

Also included a short README in the archive describing redaction rules and the mapping of Jira release tickets to change approvals.

-Rishi
Director, Platform Security
From: purchasing@finservco.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: security@finservco.com, audrey.chen@trustassure.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 16:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — invoice/PO and final confirmation

Karthik — quick admin note: we need the final Statement of Work addendum that references DL-9932 and the SIG intake scope (one-page). Also confirm whether any of the artifacts contain chargeable redaction work or additional consulting. If not, please proceed and we'll mark the vendor intake complete on our side.

If you can send the one-page addendum and confirm no extra charge by EOD Thursday we'll close the intake.

Thanks,
Procurement — FinServCo
